vocab.definition: a story that many people believe, but which is not true
vocab.example: Statistics disprove the myth that women are worse drivers than men.
vocab.cn_example: 统计数据证明，女人驾车技术比男人差的观念是错误的。

vocab.definition: to speak to a god in order to ask for help or to give thanks
vocab.example: She knelt and prayed silently.
vocab.cn_example: 她跪下默默祈祷。

vocab.definition: the belief in a god or a group of gods
vocab.example: the Christian religion
vocab.cn_example: 基督教

vocab.definition: a series of actions that are always performed in the same way
vocab.cn_meaning: 例行公事，老规矩;（尤指）仪式
vocab.example: Coffee and the newspaper are part of my morning ritual.
vocab.cn_example: 喝咖啡和读报纸是我早晨必做的事情之一。

vocab.definition: a feeling of great sadness
vocab.cn_meaning: 悲痛，伤心，悔恨;伤心事，不幸
vocab.example: The sorrow she felt over/at the death of her husband was almost too much to bear.
vocab.cn_example: 她对丈夫的去世悲痛万分，几乎难以承受。

vocab.definition: strange and frightening
vocab.cn_meaning: 怪异的;诡异的;阴森可怕的
vocab.example: It was a spooky coincidence.
vocab.cn_example: 这个巧合很诡异。

vocab.definition: a structure above or below the ground where a dead person is buried
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指重要人物的）坟墓，陵墓，冢
vocab.example: But I couldn't find her tomb.
vocab.cn_example: 但我始终没有找到她的陵墓。

vocab.definition: magical beliefs and practices that are a form of religion
vocab.cn_meaning: 伏都教（信仰魔法与鬼魂，尤流行于海地）
vocab.example: This may sound like voodoo.
vocab.cn_example: 这听起来像是巫术。

vocab.definition: causing bad luck
vocab.cn_meaning: 不幸的，不走运的，倒霉的
vocab.example: The couple were unlucky enough to be in the hotel when the terrorist group struck.
vocab.cn_example: 当恐怖团伙袭击这家宾馆时，很不幸这对夫妇正住在里面。

vocab.definition: a person who changes into a wolf every month when there’s a full moon
vocab.example: The werewolf and vampire are similar in many ways.
vocab.cn_example: 狼人和吸血鬼有很多相似之处。

vocab.definition: a woman who is thought to have magic powers
vocab.example: a witch on a broomstick
vocab.cn_example: 骑着扫把的女巫

vocab.definition: to show love and respect for a god
vocab.cn_meaning: 敬奉，崇拜，信仰（上帝或神）
vocab.example: On the island the people worshipped different gods.
vocab.cn_example: 在这个岛上，人们信仰不同的神。

vocab.definition: the words to say that children will play a trick on someone if they are not given a trick
vocab.cn_meaning: “不款待就捣蛋”（孩子们在万圣节玩这个游戏时所说的话）
vocab.example: They get dressed up like monsters, have parties and play trick or treat.
vocab.cn_example: 他们穿成鬼怪的样子、开晚会、玩不招待就使坏游戏。

vocab.definition: the feeling of being certain that something exists or is true
vocab.example: It is impossible to separate belief from emotion.
vocab.cn_example: 信仰和感情是分不开的。

vocab.definition: a piece of magic that someone does, or the special words or ceremonies
vocab.example: I've never been able to spell.
vocab.cn_example: 我一直不会拼写。

vocab.definition: a very old story or set of stories from ancient times
vocab.cn_meaning: 传说，传奇故事;民间故事
vocab.example: Jazz legend Ella Fitzgerald once sang in this bar.
vocab.cn_example: 爵士乐坛传奇人物埃拉‧菲茨杰拉德曾经在这个酒吧唱过歌。

vocab.definition: in fact or really
vocab.example: They're not married, actually.
vocab.cn_example: 他们实际上没有结婚。

vocab.definition: a spiritual creature who is God’s servant in heaven
vocab.example: Wealthy individual investors, known as angels, differ from lenders in that they want a stake in your business.
vocab.cn_example: 个体出资人是富裕的个人，跟放贷人不同，他们希望在所投资公司获得一定股份。

vocab.definition: the way someone or something looks
vocab.example: a middle-aged man of smart appearance
vocab.cn_example: 一个外表整洁的中年男子

vocab.definition: a wild animal that is large, dangerous, or unusual
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指大型或野生的）动物；野兽
vocab.example: a wild beast
vocab.cn_example: 野兽

vocab.definition: to move along with one’s body close to the ground
vocab.cn_meaning: 缓慢移动；艰难前行；爬行；匍匐前进
vocab.example: The child crawled across the floor.
vocab.cn_example: 那个孩子爬过了地板。

vocab.definition: curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at each end
vocab.cn_meaning: 新月形（物），弦月形（物），蛾眉月形（物）
vocab.example: The moon was a brightly shining crescent.
vocab.cn_example: 当时月亮是一弯明亮的新月。

vocab.definition: an imaginary creature that has pointed ears and magical powers
vocab.cn_meaning: （童话中长着尖耳朵的）小精灵，小妖精
vocab.example: Finally, the last day of school arrived and the elf was free to go.
vocab.cn_example: 终于到了上学的最后一天，小精灵可以走了。

vocab.definition: enjoying harming others
vocab.example: Each new leader would blame his predecessor for all the evils of the past.
vocab.cn_example: 每个新上任的领导人都会把过去所有的弊病全都归罪于他的前任。

vocab.definition: an imaginary creature that looks like a small person with wings
vocab.example: Do you believe in fairies?
vocab.cn_example: 你相信有小仙子吗？

vocab.definition: completely untrue
vocab.cn_meaning: 虚假的，不真实的；错误的
vocab.example: "Three plus three is seven. True or false?" "False."
vocab.cn_example: “3加3等于7。对还是错？”“错。”

vocab.definition: a spirit of a person who has died
vocab.example: The ghost of the old dictator still lingers on.
vocab.cn_example: 那个老独裁者在人们的记忆中阴魂不散。

vocab.definition: the hard, pointed thing on the head of some animals
vocab.example: The driver blew/sounded (informal honked) her horn.
vocab.cn_example: 那个司机按了喇叭。

vocab.definition: to chase animals in order to catch or kill them
vocab.example: to go on a fox/deer hunt
vocab.cn_example: 去猎狐／鹿

vocab.definition: a picture of a person or an idea of how something is
vocab.example: I have an image in my mind of how I want the garden to be.
vocab.cn_example: 我对花园该是什么样心里有底。

vocab.definition: cannot be seen
vocab.example: The aircraft is designed to be invisible to radar.
vocab.cn_example: 这种飞机的设计目的是能躲过雷达探测。

vocab.definition: an old story about people and events that may not be true
vocab.cn_meaning: 传说，传奇故事;民间故事
vocab.example: Jazz legend Ella Fitzgerald once sang in this bar.
vocab.cn_example: 爵士乐坛传奇人物埃拉‧菲茨杰拉德曾经在这个酒吧唱过歌。

vocab.definition: a thing that happens to a person because of chance
vocab.example: It was just luck that I asked for a job at the right time.
vocab.cn_example: 真是机缘巧合，我刚好在合适的时机开口说想找份工作。

vocab.definition: a mythical sea creature that has a woman’s head and body, and a fish’s tail
vocab.example: "Oh," cried Wendy, "to see a mermaid!"
vocab.cn_example: “噢，”温迪叫道，“去看美人鱼！”

vocab.definition: strange, unknown, or difficult to understand
vocab.cn_meaning: 神秘的事物，难以理解的事物，谜
vocab.example: She's an actress whose inner life has remained mysterious, despite the many interviews she has given.
vocab.cn_example: 作为一名演员，她虽然接受过多次采访，但私生活依然很神秘。

vocab.definition: from a story that most people think is not true
vocab.cn_meaning: 神话的，神话中的；虚构的
vocab.example: Start living life here and now instead of waiting for that mythical day when you'll be slim.
vocab.cn_example: 现在就赶快回到现实中来吧，不要坐着幻想身材苗条的那一天。

vocab.definition: an animal looks like a white horse with a long straight horn on its head
vocab.example: A glorious well-oiled angel rides on a winged unicorn.
vocab.cn_example: 一位光彩照人的天使骑着一只有翼的独角兽。

vocab.definition: relating to the sea and the creatures that live there
vocab.example: Bezanik is diving to collect marine organisms.
vocab.cn_example: 贝赞尼克正在潜水采集海洋生物。

vocab.definition: not real, but produced from pictures or ideas in your mind
vocab.example: Lots of children have imaginary friends.
vocab.cn_example: 许多孩子都有假想的朋友。

vocab.definition: a flat part on the body of some large sea animals
vocab.cn_meaning: （海豹、企鹅等海洋生物用来游泳的）鳍肢，鳍足
vocab.example: The seal's flipper is homologous with the human arm.
vocab.cn_example: 海豹的鳍肢与人类的手臂同源。

vocab.definition: to recognize and correctly name someone or something
vocab.example: First of all we must identify the problem areas.
vocab.cn_example: 首先我们必须找出问题所在。

vocab.definition: to have someone’s complete interest and attention
vocab.example: Angels fascinate, as Christmas-card-makers rediscover every year.
vocab.cn_example: 天使令人着迷，正如圣诞卡制造商们每年一再发现的那样。

vocab.definition: the hard, pointed mouth of a bird
vocab.example: Birds use their beaks to pick up food.
vocab.cn_example: 鸟用嘴叼食。

vocab.definition: to mate in order to have babies
vocab.example: Favouritism breeds resentment.
vocab.cn_example: 偏袒招致怨恨。

vocab.definition: large mammals raised on farms for their milk or meat
vocab.example: beef/dairy cattle
vocab.cn_example: 肉／奶牛

vocab.definition: a sharp, curved part on the toe of an animal or bird
vocab.example: Our cat likes to sharpen her claws on the legs of the dining table.
vocab.cn_example: 我们的猫喜欢在餐桌腿上磨爪子。

vocab.definition: a sea animal that has a hard shell, eight legs, and two large claws
vocab.example: I can't remember when I last had crab.
vocab.cn_example: 我不记得上次吃蟹是什么时候了。

vocab.definition: anything that is living, such as an animal, fish, or insect
vocab.example: Rainforests are filled with amazing creatures.
vocab.cn_example: 雨林中满是奇异的生灵。

vocab.definition: a type of animal or plant does not exist anymore
vocab.example: There is concern that the giant panda will soon become extinct.
vocab.cn_example: 有人担心大熊猫不久就会灭绝。

vocab.definition: one of the light, soft parts that cover a bird’s body
vocab.example: peacock/ostrich feathers
vocab.cn_example: 孔雀／鸵鸟羽毛

vocab.definition: to be born by coming out of an egg
vocab.example: an escape hatch
vocab.cn_example: 逃生出口

vocab.definition: a sea animal that has a round, transparent body and can sting you
vocab.example: Ouch! A jellyfish sits on my knee.
vocab.cn_example: 嗷！一只水母坐在我的膝盖上。

vocab.definition: a large animal with yellow fur and black spots
vocab.example: Which has spots, a leopard or a tiger?
vocab.cn_example: 有斑点的是豹还是虎？

vocab.definition: an animal’s foot that has nails or claws
vocab.example: I found paw prints in the kitchen.
vocab.cn_example: 我在厨房里发现了爪印。

vocab.definition: a large deer with long, wide antlers
vocab.example: Santa Claus travels in a sleigh pulled by reindeer.
vocab.cn_example: 圣诞老人乘坐驯鹿拉的雪橇出行。

vocab.definition: to make a deep, very loud noise
vocab.example: We could hear the lions roaring at the other end of the zoo.
vocab.cn_example: 我们可以听到狮子在动物园的另一端咆哮。

vocab.definition: a part at the back of an animal’s body that can move
vocab.example: The dog wagged its tail excitedly.
vocab.cn_example: 那条狗兴奋地摇着尾巴。

vocab.definition: a reptile with a soft body covered by a hard shell
vocab.example: Experts say if the island is not protected, the spill could wipe out the gulf's turtle population.
vocab.cn_example: 专家们说如果那座小岛得不到保护，此次泄露有可能使该海湾地区的海龟灭绝。

vocab.definition: animals and insects that live in a natural environment
vocab.example: a documentary on Peruvian wildlife
vocab.cn_example: 关于秘鲁野生生物的纪录片

vocab.definition: a wild animal that is similar to a dog
vocab.example: Wolves hunt in groups known as packs.
vocab.cn_example: 狼群集体觅食。

vocab.definition: a long thin creature with no bones and no legs
vocab.example: The kiwi bird eats worms, other invertebrates, and berries.
vocab.cn_example: 奇翼鸟以蠕虫、其他无脊椎动物和浆果为食。

vocab.definition: a person who takes care of the animals in a zoo
vocab.cn_meaning: 动物园饲养员;动物园管理员
vocab.example: At the end of the day, the zookeeper comes and gives the mime a raise for being such a good attraction as a gorilla.
vocab.cn_example: 一天结束的时候，动物园管理员给这个哑剧演员加了薪水，因为这样一个大猩猩更有吸引力。

vocab.definition: to study a subject in detail
vocab.example: Embryo research is an emotive issue.
vocab.cn_example: 胚胎研究是个让人情绪激动的问题。

vocab.definition: having a shape that is like a curve and not straight
vocab.example: Her spine curved.
vocab.cn_example: 她的脊柱弯了。

vocab.definition: existing in the present time
vocab.example: Or to help modern-day readers to understand something historical, maybe these writers think a familiar frame of reference is needed.
vocab.cn_example: 或者是为了帮助现代读者理解历史，也许这些作者认为，这需要一个为人所熟知的参考架构。

vocab.definition: either of the long curved teeth that stick out of the mouth of elephants and some other animals
vocab.example: The second blind felt the elephant's tusk.
vocab.cn_example: 第二个瞎子摸到了大象的象牙。

vocab.definition: an animal that moves very slowly, has grey fur, and lives in trees
vocab.example: Sloth does not set in until after gluttony and avarice.
vocab.cn_example: 懒惰是在暴食和贪婪之后才开始的。
